 Discover True Relaxation in Nature’s Embrace

Step away from everyday stress and immerse yourself in the peaceful beauty of Door County’s forests and lakes. Our traditional wood-fired Finnish sauna offers a rejuvenating escape that blends cultural tradition with natural wellness. Feel the tension melt away as you enjoy the soothing heat, then refresh your senses with a brisk cold plunge—an invigorating practice proven to boost circulation and promote overall health.

What’s Included

Access to a private wood-fired sauna

Optional cold plunge experience in a natural or controlled setting

Overview of sauna benefits and usage for first-timers

Scenic forest or lakefront setting for maximum tranquility

Why Choose Our Sauna Experience?

Authentic: Wood-fired sauna inspired by Finnish tradition

Scenic: Nestled in the quiet beauty of Door County

Restorative: Promotes deep relaxation, better sleep, and circulation

Perfect For: Solo guests, couples, or small wellness-focused groups

Ready to Recharge?
Reclaim your calm in Door County’s most peaceful natural setting. Book your sauna session now and give yourself the gift of pure relaxation.

Sauna Use Restrictions

Do not use the sauna if you are pregnant, unless approved by a physician.

Individuals with heart disease, high/low blood pressure, respiratory conditions, or circulatory problems should consult a doctor before use.

No sauna use under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or medications that impair sweating or awareness.

Do not use the sauna if you are ill, dehydrated, or have a fever.

Children should not use the sauna unless supervised and approved by a guardian/physician.

Limit sessions to 10–20 minutes at a time; exit immediately if dizziness, nausea, or discomfort occurs.

No food, glass containers, or electronic devices allowed inside the sauna.

Shower before entering; proper attire or towels required.

Do not pour water or substances on heating elements unless explicitly permitted.

Re-entry after cooling down is allowed only if you feel well.
